answer: Here is what I would raise at your check-up, most urgent first. (1) Hydrochlorothiazide: the hospital told you to stop it on March 5, 2026, when your sodium was low (123). Your primary care chart still lists it as active with refills left, a May 2026 medication list says you take it once a day, and your sodium was still low (134) on June 15, 2026. Please confirm whether you are taking it and ask for a sodium recheck. (2) Lung nodule: an October 18, 2025 CT found a 7 mm solid nodule in your right lower lung. The radiologist advised a non-contrast chest CT in 6 to 12 months, a window that closed on October 18, 2026. I see no chest CT since then, so ask whether it has been ordered or done somewhere else. (3) Thyroid: your March 3, 2026 TSH was high at 7.9 with a normal free T4, and the discharge asked for a repeat TSH and free T4 in 6 to 8 weeks. No repeat is recorded. (4) Medication list: several medicines appear more than once from different sources (amlodipine, losartan, metformin, Claritin, hydrochlorothiazide). An older lisinopril entry still shows as active, although lisinopril was stopped in September 2025 for cough and replaced by losartan. Taking lisinopril with losartan is not advised, so bring all your bottles and have the list reconciled. (5) Cholesterol: your September 2025 LDL was 142 and HDL 48, with triglycerides 155. You have type 2 diabetes, and no cholesterol-lowering medicine is recorded. Ask whether you should be on a statin and whether your cholesterol needs rechecking. (6) Kidney stone: the October 2025 stone is still listed as active, and that day's urine test showed large blood. I see no repeat urine test and no urology visit. Ask whether the stone has passed and whether you need a repeat urinalysis. (7) Diabetes checks: your June 2026 A1c of 6.6% is close to target. Not recorded: a urine albumin test, a foot exam, or completion of the diabetes education referral from September 2025. (8) Vaccines: you had one Shingrix dose on November 8, 2025; the second dose, due 2 to 6 months later, is not recorded. No flu vaccine for this season and no tetanus booster (Tdap or Td) is recorded. (9) Screening: no mammogram or cervical screening appears in these records. They may have happened elsewhere, so check. On track: your blood pressure was 128/80 in June, at goal; your May 2026 eye exam showed no diabetic eye damage; your kidney function (eGFR 71) and potassium were normal in June; and your 2019 colonoscopy was normal, so the next is due around 2029. These records cannot show what you are actually taking or whether any test was done outside them.
